source_locator: Data and Methods p. 3; Results p. 4 and Conclusions p. 5. Historical interpretation: Schott/McCreary (2001), sections 3.2–3.2.2, printed pp. 28–31.
source_access: 2019 original six-page PDF text read, including Methods/Results/Conclusions and figure captions; no figure digitized. 2001 original review sections 3.2–3.2.2 and Figure 25 caption read. Original Taft (1967) source not inspected; 2015 Chen et al. full publisher page returned 403 and not used as full-paper evidence.
scope: Dated local section at 90 E; historical basin observations remain separate from a connected current axis.
layer: 2017 reported strong saline eastward band within 80–150 m; not a uniform axis layer or full width at every depth. Historical upper-thermocline definitions can depend on overlying flow.
time_convention: Local 1–3 March 2017 section, not recurring seasonal geometry. Historical February–May 1994 and August 1994 occurrences at 80.5 E remain separate evidence.

historical_definition_review.source_locator: Sections 3.2–3.2.2, printed pp. 28–31; Figure 25 caption p. 30.

remaining_gates: Define undercurrent using both subsurface and overlying profiles at each sampled longitude/time.
Recover compatible longitudinal axes before connecting historical positions or measuring whole-current length.
Diagnose transverse velocity edges; reported current/water-mass band limits are a different metric.
Recover repeated compatible dates and sections before seasonal dimensions; one local occurrence cannot define an annual cycle.
